# OC Trial Group

> > OC Trial Group is an Orange County trial law firm specializing in trust and estate litigation, real estate disputes, business law, and personal injury cases throughout California.

Founded by trial attorneys including Blaine Brown and Ryan W. Young, the firm handles complex probate matters under the California Probate Code, fiduciary disputes, undue influence claims, and property litigation. The firm serves clients across Orange County communities including Dana Point, Irvine, and San Juan Capistrano.

## Key Topics

- Trust litigation
- Estate litigation
- California Probate Code
- Fiduciary duties
- Undue influence
- Beneficiary rights
- Real estate disputes
- Property disputes
- Estate planning
- Trust disputes
- Power of attorney abuse
- Probate Code Section 850
- Will contests
- Business litigation
- Personal injury

## Trust & Estate Litigation Practice

- [Orange County Undue Influence Attorney](https://www.octrial.com/practice-areas/trust-and-estate-litigation/undue-influence): Undue influence claims in CA wills & trusts under Probate Code

- [How Long Do I Have to Contest a Trust or Will in California?](https://www.octrial.com/how-long-do-i-have-to-contest-a-trust-or-will-in-california): CA trust & will contest deadlines including 120-day period
- [How to Determine if a Decedent Had a Valid Trust in California](https://www.octrial.com/how-to-determine-if-a-decedent-had-a-valid-trust-in-california): Guide to verifying trust validity in CA estate administration
- [Addressing Abuse of Power: What to Do When an Agent Misuses Power of Attorney](https://www.octrial.com/addressing-abuse-of-power-what-to-do-when-an-agent-misuses-power-of-attorney): Legal remedies for power of attorney abuse in California
